newsitem.title: USA: Centennial Technologies faces class action.
newsitem.headline: Centennial Technologies faces class action.

text.p: A class action lawsuit has been filed in a Massachusetts court for people who bought stock in Centennial Technologies Inc on the open market between August 21 and February 10.
The suit was file by the law offices of Dennis J. Johnson,

The complaint charges Centennial, of Billerica, Mass., and several officers with violations of sections 10(b) and 20(a) of the Securities Exchange Act arising from Centennial's announcement before the opening of the New York Stock Exchange on February 11 that its financial results were materially overstated during the class period.

Centennial's former chairman and chief executive, Emanual Pinez, was arrested by the Federal Bureau of Investigation for securities fraud and insider trading and the United States Securities and Exchange Commission has recently obtained an order freezing Pinez's assets, the law firms said.

The complaint also names James Murphy, Centennial's chief financial officer, who was relieved of his duties by Centennial until after it completes its investigation into the falsification of Centennial's financial statements.
